name: Tessera vs Raydium SOL/USDC arbitrage
description: Creates a cross-venue SOL/USDC price gap for an arbitrage strategy to realize. Tessera (a non-Anchor prop-AMM) is priced at $80 via the raw-layout override kind; the Raydium CLMM SOL/USDC pool (config index 8) is priced at $75 via the existing IDL-based raydium-clmm-custom template. A strategy buys SOL cheap on Raydium (~$75) and sells it dear on Tessera ($80) for ~$5/SOL. Demonstrates both override kinds - raw byte-offset and IDL/borsh - in a single scenario.
